title: Check for multiple imports on one line.
summary: According to PEP 8, "imports should usually be on separate lines." Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle and made it stable in v0.0.191.

title: Checks for imports that are not at the top of the file.
summary: According to PEP 8, "imports are always put at the top of the file, just after any module comments and docstrings, and before module globals and constants." Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle and made it stable in v0.0.28.
